items.label: 2-IN-1 TABLET PC KIT – BOOST WORK & STUDY EFFICIENCY
items.value: This tablet with keyboard and pen comes with mouse, Silver foldable protective case, anti-glare screen protector, charging head,USB-C charger cable and user manual—ready out of the box. With Google and split-screen functionality, it easily turns into a mini laptop for typing, designing, or note-taking—your best-value 10 inch tablet for school or work.(Tip:Tablets are all the same color, they all silver. The color difference is reflected in the tablet case.)

items.label: ALL-DAY PRODUCTIVITY – 26+256GB & 8000mAh
items.value: This 10-inch Android 15 tablet features 4GB + 22GB virtual memory (totaling 26GB) and 256GB storage, delivering seamless multitasking. It also supports expansion via MicroSD card (not included) up to 2TB, offering ample capacity for storing vast collections of photos, videos, and large files. Boasting an 8000mAh high-capacity battery, it delivers outstanding battery life to keep you powered through busy study days, long trips, or creative sessions

items.label: ANDROID 15 & 5G WIFI – FASTER, SMARTER, MORE SECURE
items.value: The new tablet with Keyboard bundle is powered by the fast, smart and secure Android 15 OS with powerful built-in 3562 Octa-core processors for an efficient and smooth streaming experience. No hassle from Bloatware. This Android tablet comes with the Gemini AI engine, enjoy intelligent task optimization, faster app response, and smarter performance.Dual-band 2.4G/5G Wi-Fi offers faster speeds and minimizes network latency. Bluetooth 5.0 enables seamless wireless pairing with headphones, speakers and other accessories

items.label: IMMERSIVE CINEMA EXPERIENCE – HD IPS DISPLAY & SMART LENS
items.value: The tablet features a 10.1-inch IPS display that delivers vivid visuals with crisp details. Certified by Widevine L1, it supports 1080P HD video playback on platforms like Amazon Prime Video, ensuring immersive streaming. 13MP rear camera and 5MP front camera help you capture life's beautiful moments with clarity. Powered by Android 15, the Smart Lens feature enables text recognition and translation along with object identification. The GPS positioning system provides precise navigation and location services, making it an ideal companion for travel and outdoor adventures

items.label: STABLE CONNECTIVITY – AI CAMERA & 5G WIFI & BT5.0
items.value: Dual-band 5G WiFi boosts speeds by 30% and seamless wireless connectivity via Bluetooth 5.0, blending speed and security for seamless access to this AI Android tablet. The 13MP rear camera captures crisp, detailed shots—perfect for scanning documents, snapping landscapes, or casual photography. A 5MP front camera enhances video calls and selfies with AI-powered optimization, even in low light. The USB-C port supports bidirectional fast charging, ensuring you can recharge quickly and get back to your tasks, games, or movies without long downtime

items.value: 10 inch Tablet, Bluetooth keyboard, mouse, stylus, protective case, protective film, USB charger, USB-C cable, OTG cable, user manual
